thread_title: S. flava red infused, vigorous OUTLAW site, Bay Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. flava red infused, vigorous OUTLAW site, Bay Co, FL

posts.body_html:
I don't whether to call this an ornata or rubricorpora! This clone originates from the "outlaw" site in Bay Co, FL, which many of you know is some of this disjunct population that is a bit of a distance from the "main" extant populations of flavas. County lines are man made and they have little to do with diversity: these are drastically different from the rubricorporas and other flava types in Bay Co, FL!

Anyways, check out this ornata? Or rubricorpora? Ya, it's pretty amazing color-wise! It's not vigorous as the name suggest, but that's what a homie that I got it from labeled it, so there you have it! Pics taken probably 6/4/22:

Trap looks a little bit gnarly, probably because we've been having heat waves followed by days that don't get higher than 62F! Temperature swings during development of pitchers can do that!
